_about: Every choice that trades depth for cost. docs/SWITCHES.md is generated from this file by `python3 scripts/switches.py docs`; edit here. A switch never caps a verdict or a confidence level: a lighter run states what it did not do, and the judgment and the owner weigh that.

reading.buys: Every in-scope page read once and recorded page by page.
reading.loses: The page-by-page record of what was read; specialists read their own domain's documents instead.
reading.confidence: Accounting and governance findings rest on what specialists chose to open.

digest.buys: Web summaries of each report, kept as tier-6 leads and page-confirmed by script.
digest.loses: The leads that point specialists at what to read. Off only with reading on.
digest.confidence: None by itself: digest items are never evidence.

second_reads.buys: An independent second read of every chunk, with conflicts adjudicated.
second_reads.loses: The cross-check of a reader's misses. Only meaningful with reading on.

effort.loses: Reasoning depth per turn; not measured yet what that costs in findings.

specialists.buys: Every domain researched by its own independent head.
specialists.loses: core runs financials, filings, management, forecasting, valuation and bear-case: no industry, moat, scuttlebutt, concalls or special-situations reports, so thin evidence for some layers.
specialists.confidence: Moat, industry and ground-truth judgments rest on indirect evidence.

verifier_sample.buys: More of each specialist's claims re-opened at the source (full 8, small 4).
verifier_sample.loses: Fewer claims re-opened, so a misread is likelier to pass.
verifier_sample.confidence: Lower assurance that claims say what their sources say.

synthesis.buys: Independent theme analysts and section writers, five or six and seven sessions.
synthesis.loses: compact uses two theme sessions and two writers. All four layer analysts still run, and every item still gets a recorded fate.
synthesis.confidence: Fewer independent eyes on how the evidence connects.

audit.buys: The whole audit (full 30 claims and 15 restatements).
audit.confidence: Lower assurance on the final report.

history_years.buys: A longer record: more cycles, and more of management's history.
history_years.loses: Below 10 years the record may miss a full cycle.
history_years.confidence: Through-cycle judgments rest on fewer cycles.

gap_rounds.buys: Every closable gap closed before synthesis.
gap_rounds.loses: Closable gaps stay open after one round, and the report says which.

early_stop.buys: A pause that asks the owner when a red flag appears early, before the rest is spent. Never an automatic kill.
early_stop.loses: Off spends the full run on a name with a red flag, which a deep run may want anyway.

canaries.buys: Known-false claims mixed into the checkers' samples: a measured catch rate for every run.
canaries.loses: The only measure of whether the checkers are working.
canaries.confidence: None directly: it measures assurance rather than adding it.

spend_ceiling.buys: An automatic pause when a run's recorded cost reaches this many dollars.
spend_ceiling.loses: With none, nothing pauses a run on cost.

reading_transport.buys: plan uses the subscription; batch reads through the API at half price, with real money and an API key.
reading_transport.loses: Nothing in depth: it changes who pays.

combinations.why: with reading off the digest is Stage 0
second reads apply only to the reading stage
the batch transport applies only to the reading stage
